title: Local Alert Weekly Affected Radius Trend
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=local:alert affected_radius_m=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(affected_radius_m) as avg_duration, max(affected_radius_m) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst affected radius for local alert events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture affected_radius_m on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average affected radius with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether local alert tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
